summary: First full-app test after implementation. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass after fixing an ObjectId serialization bug on create endpoints. Frontend: All critical flows verified — landing loads with hero CTAs, header nav works, order mode picker auto-opens on /commander, product cards + product modal + add-to-cart + sticky cart + checkout modal all functional. Order successfully created and redirected to /suivi/{id}. Reservation flow completes with success screen 'Votre table est réservée'. Admin owner login (AngelCED26) reaches dashboard showing all 8 tabs including 'Emails clients'; staff login (AnCED25) correctly hides the emails tab. Menu tab shows seeded products with 'Nouveau produit' button. Order status advance works. VAT rules correct (2.6% takeaway, 8.1% delivery, inclusive).

issues: Radix Dialog accessibility warnings: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent. Not blocking but should be fixed (add DialogDescription or aria-describedby).

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) ObjectId serialization: added .copy() before insert_one on create_category, create_addon_group, create_product, create_promo endpoints to avoid returning MongoDB _id (ObjectId) which is not JSON serializable and was causing 500 on POST /api/products (and would have affected /api/categories, /api/addon-groups, /api/admin/promos).
(Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix Dialog components (OrderModePicker, CheckoutModal, product modal) to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `insert_one(doc)` mutates the dict adding `_id: ObjectId`. Always pass `.copy()` for any doc that will be returned. Fixed in POST create routes for products/categories/addon-groups/promos; orders and reservations already used .copy().

server.py: `list_products(admin, user)` accepts a `user` query parameter which is dead / unsafe (should be removed — admins should use /api/products/all which is properly protected). Not exploitable but confusing surface.
server.py file is ~680 lines, still manageable but consider splitting routers (products, orders, admin, auth) into separate modules as it grows.

auth.py: passwords hashed at import time from env — fine for local dev; note that startup cost is negligible, and this ties the module to env being loaded first (which server.py does via load_dotenv before import — good).
reservations create route sets `deleted` for orders but reservations has no soft-delete; consistent scheme could be adopted later.

CORS uses `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=True` — this combination is invalid per spec and can be silently downgraded by browsers. For production, replace with the actual frontend origin.

rca of the issue: Bug found & fixed: POST /api/products (and analogous create routes for categories/addon-groups/promos) returned 500 with `ValueError: [TypeError('ObjectId object is not iterable')]`. Root cause: `motor.insert_one(doc)` mutates the dict in place, adding `_id: ObjectId(...)`. FastAPI then attempted to JSON-serialize the returned dict, which fails on ObjectId. Fix: pass `doc.copy()` to `insert_one` so the returned `doc` remains ObjectId-free. Orders/reservations endpoints already followed this pattern; the four affected create endpoints have been aligned.
